Interface QTSTradeService

public interface QTSTradeService
QTSurfer Trade Service

Order placement is offered on two surfaces. The engine-typed one is what callers should use: it speaks Instrument, OrderSide, StopIntention and plain amounts, so placing an order never requires naming a connector library's DTO, and a second exchange can be implemented without inheriting one library's order model. The connector-typed surface below it is what an implementation actually talks to its exchange with, and is the extension point implementations override.

Both surfaces place what they are given, unchanged. Rounding an amount to an instrument's step size, rounding a price to its counter scale and checking the notional against the exchange minimum all need instrument metadata and happen a level up, in the order-execution layer that holds it.
